author: Mark Atwood
text: Maintainer risk: MEDIUM — the new code (space_set, ephemeral, push) is well-tested in isolation but interacts with two cross-cutting decisions (URI-form ChatContact.id; extras-preservation + serde tag) that have at least one real correctness issue (SenderId 'self' sentinel collision) and a handful of consistency drift cases (ChatPresenceEvent.presence as String, ChatTypingEvent.sender_id as String, README/EphemeralMessage::Unknown mismatch). None of these are deployment-blocking; all of them will generate repeat questions or silent misbehavior in downstream consumers if not addressed.
